equations.text: T_out = T_in + dp_fan / (rho * cp_air * eta_fan), which equals T_in + dp_ref * (omega_fan / omega_ref)^2 / (rho_ref * cp_air * eta_fan) because rho cancels

uncertainty_method: First-order propagation with analytic relative sensitivities. Inputs and parameters are treated as independent; each frame uses the standard uncertainty of its selected input samples; parameter uncertainty is systematic across frames. u(T_out)^2 = u(T_in)^2 + u(T_out - T_in)^2.
assumptions: Quasi-steady: fan speed, pressure rise and air temperature respond instantly to crankshaft speed inside declared steady windows.
Fan affinity laws on one fixed system curve: pressure rise scales with the square of fan speed and with density.
All fan shaft work is dissipated into the air between the inlet and outlet stations; the housing is adiabatic.
Constant belt slip within one parameter set; no belt dynamics.
Probe thermal lag and recovery factor are neglected.
validity: Declared steady windows of operating case OC-STATIONARY-HOLDS, inside the contract operating envelope. Transients and frames outside the envelope are no-claim states.
implementation: Executed only by the deterministic offline replay of issue #511; this card defines the equations, inputs, outputs and parameters that replay must bind by hash.
